user.title: Energy Data Importer
user.description:
Import historical energy/water data from external data sources into Home Assistant.

**Important**: This integration directly modifies your Home Assistant database. Always have a recent backup before using this integration!

**Multiple Instances**: You can add multiple instances to organize imports from different data sources (e.g., 'Grid Energy', 'Solar', 'Gas').

For detailed documentation, see: {docs_url}
